items.name: Garlic Parmesan Meatballs
items.desc: Loaded with protein and flavor, these healthy baked turkey meatballs are going to be an amazing addition to your meal rotation! Topped with our creamy garlic parmesan sauce and served with roasted potatoes and steamed green beans on the side, these make healthy feel decadent!

items.name: Harvest Bowl w/ Chicken
items.desc: Fall flavors take center stage in this hearty grain bowl! We've mixed the best of the season here. Also available in a plant-based version.

items.name: Southwest Beef Burrito Bowl
items.desc: Rich and savory, with just enough spice to make your mouth wake up and say hello, but not so much that you're sweating and diving for the nearest glass of water. Served with rice, black beans, and pico de gallo, this bowl will turn up your taco Tuesday!

items.name: Breakfast Pizza Bake
items.desc: It's a breakfast pizza you can eat without feeling sluggish or guilty afterwards! We took the traditional flavors you enjoy and crafted them into a healthier option that doesn't skimp on flavor.

items.name: The Fox Salad
items.desc: Two of our favorite root vegetables, carrots and beets, take center stage in this amazingly fresh and tasty salad named after one of our first supporters. This was Jody's favorite salad, and we have renamed it in her memory.

items.name: The Fox Salad With Chicken
items.desc: Two of our favorite root vegetables, carrots and beets, take center stage in this amazingly fresh and tasty salad, topped with juicy, tender chicken. Named after one of our first supporters, this was Jody's favorite salad, and we have renamed it in her memory.

items.name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Energy Bites
items.desc: Our original recipe - these aren't your basic energy bites. They're loaded with whole foods and so much goodness for your body! A healthy way to have a sweet treat or a midafternoon pick-me-up. At 5g protein per ball of goodness, these whole-food treats will treat your body well!
